name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 25 times in 8 visits over 77 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 52 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.2 days starting 2025-07-03, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.81 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
